verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a web-scraping/tool API product that exposes itself as an MCP server (docs-5, probe-3) so agents can consume ITS tools — the reverse of this story, which asks whether Firecrawl itself can plug in and consume other MCP servers' tools. As a tool/service rather than an orchestrating agent, that client-side capability is not a fit for this product category.
